title: Preprocessing machine step
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean string, let $c$ be a configuration of the zero-work-tape preprocessing machine on input $x$, and let $q$ be a preprocessing state. If the state of $c$ is $q$, then one step of the machine on $c$ is the result of applying the action prescribed by the preprocessing transition function at state $q$, with the symbols read from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: Input $x$ is a list of Booleans
Configuration $c$ has zero work tapes, Boolean symbols, preprocessing states, and input $x$
